Twenty comments

Trip to Dingle

This is the last tune of the set Dingle Berries on Lunasa`s album Se. Great polka. I failed to find it anywhere on the net so I had to write it down from the record (from my memory, to be correct, `cause it is not necessarily the exact Lunasa version - it may be slightly different but playable anyway). I suspect there is at least one more polka by the same name.

↳ Posted by Viking of St.Petersburg on August 3rd, 2006.

The Trip To Dingle, X:12

I learned this great polka recently. This setting is the way I learned it by ear from a concertina player who said he picked up this tune at last year’s Fleadh. Apparently this is the way it was taught to him. Interesting how the parts are played twice!
